content:
Starting with iOS 26.4, Apple has supported conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category includes AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will join CarPlay starting from iOS 27. The iPhone software update is currently in beta and will officially launch in September.

Meanwhile, the fourth third-party AI chatbot, Meta AI, has officially added support for Apple CarPlay.

The Meta AI iPhone app is now available on Apple CarPlay — but there is one thing to note

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app now supports CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps that already support CarPlay, including ChatGPT, Perplexity and Grok.

However, Meta AI's support for CarPlay still appears to be in a limited testing phase for now.

Although the iPhone app will appear on CarPlay, opening it may currently display a "not supported" message.

In my personal case, when opening the app on CarPlay, the screen showed "Your account is not currently supported for the Meta AI experience."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see whether CarPlay support was limited to paid accounts only. However, the message inside the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. Actual experience may vary.

Regardless, before Siri AI is officially rolled out to all users, it is indeed encouraging to see the fourth major chatbot app land on CarPlay.

This is precisely the core advantage of CarPlay: seamlessly integrating your existing iPhone apps into your car. Built-in infotainment systems simply cannot offer such a rich and diverse range of options.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also landed on Mac. The desktop version is far more powerful than the iPhone and iPad versions.
